rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip code, matched to a single user. They reviewed the user’s orders via tools, correctly identified the laptop order as pending, and noted that the only delivered item was a camera. Since the user originally wanted a return but the order was still pending, the agent offered cancellation as an eligible action. Before making any change, the agent clearly stated the intended action (cancel order #W2417020) and requested explicit confirmation and a reason. After receiving confirmation, the agent executed the cancellation via the appropriate tool, which returned status “cancelled” and indicated a refund transaction. The agent then accurately informed the user that a full refund was issued to the original payment method (gift card). All actions were within policy: correct authentication, read checks before write, explicit confirmation before changing the order, and no unsupported or fabricated information. The request was completed successfully.
